check: reset clears bank latch
idle: flash P not enabled, transceiver off
P1 read: flash OE low, CE low, WE high
P1 read: flash word address = 68K address >> 1 (A2 -> FA1), upper bits 0
P1 read: 0x1234 reaches the 68K data bus
after read: bus released
bank write: transceiver enabled toward the flash side
bank write: flash not written (WE high) and not read (OE high)
bank latch now holds bank 1
outside the port window the bank bits do not reach the flash
P2 read: flash OE low
P2 read: word address = (5 MB + 8) / 2
P2 read: data reaches the bus
ADPCM-A: chip 0 selected for bit23=0, chip 1 not
ADPCM-A: byte address reconstructed
ADPCM-A: sample byte 0xA5 driven onto SDRAD during SDROE
ADPCM-A: bus released after SDROE
PROG: P flash OE/WE pulled inactive, transceiver disabled
PROG: 68K address buffers tri-stated (FA0 undriven)
PROG: 595 outputs enabled
PROG: sample data buffers disabled even with SDROE low
PROG: MCU address reaches the P flash (FA3=1), OE low
PROG: flash data arrives on the MCU pins (FD = 0x1234), nothing else drives FD
